instruction: Debra has requested me to buy "Sullivans Ceramic Vase Set" on amazon for them as their card is currently blocked. Place the order and forward the confirmation email containing the receipt to them, and make a venmo request to them for the total cost of the order, with a description note, "For Amazon Order".
notes: Flow: passwords -> phone login + search_contacts for Debra's email -> amazon login, search product, add to cart (clear_cart_first=true so the order holds exactly one item, quantity defaults to 1), look up a payment card and address, place order, show_order to read paid_amount -> gmail login, find the auto-generated 'Amazon Order Confirmation' thread for the new order, show_thread to get the email id, forward that email (email_addresses = [Debra's email]) which yields the 'Fwd: Amazon Order Confirmation' email with response_to_email_id set -> venmo login and create_payment_request(user_email=Debra, amount=order paid_amount, description='For Amazon Order') -> complete_task with no answer. Static init facts (contact-query, product-query, total-of, confirmation-thread, email-in-thread, requester, wanted-product, wanted-note) only link objects structurally; knowledge predicates (known-email, known-id, known-total) are produced by the lookup actions. supervisor-complete-task carries only non-API record parameters so its precondition can mirror the ground goal; it is the only action setting (task-completed) and every other action requires (not (task-completed)). The supervisor object troy is declared but unused (usernames: email for amazon/gmail/venmo, phone number for phone).

plan: (gmail-forward-email-from-thread thread-order-confirmation email-order-confirmation email-of-debra token-amazon debra order-new)
(venmo-create-payment-request email-of-debra amount-order-total token-amazon note-for-amazon-order debra order-new)
